body:
## Summary — SDK compatibility

The SigV4 layer accepts only the classic streaming payload `STREAMING-AWS4-HMAC-SHA256-PAYLOAD` and **deliberately rejects the trailer variants** `STREAMING-AWS4-HMAC-SHA256-PAYLOAD-TRAILER` and `STREAMING-UNSIGNED-PAYLOAD-TRAILER` with **403** (`crates/gateway-s3/src/sigv4.rs:500-515`, tests `:1013-1023`). Modern boto3 / aws-sdk / aws-cli **default to the checksum-trailer framing** (`x-amz-checksum-*` + `-TRAILER`), so **default-configured current SDKs get 403 on PUT**.

## Scope for Alpha
- Parse the aws-chunked **trailer** framing: consume the trailing checksum headers after the terminating zero-length chunk, for both the signed (`-PAYLOAD-TRAILER`) and unsigned (`-UNSIGNED-PAYLOAD-TRAILER`) variants.
- Verify the per-chunk signatures where present; validate the declared trailer checksum against the streamed content.

## Acceptance
- A default-configured `aws s3 cp` / boto3 PUT (checksum trailer on) succeeds instead of 403.
- The existing `STREAMING-AWS4-HMAC-SHA256-PAYLOAD` path stays green.

Part of the 0.1-Alpha S3 completion epic. Without this, several other Alpha items look done but fail against default SDKs.

title: s3: accept aws-chunked TRAILER SigV4 framing (modern SDK default → 403 today)
